# QS-CFW-7434-20 — Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (1045)

Revision: Rev C  
This revision supersedes Rev B.  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-7434-20

Scope
- This document defines the quality acceptance criteria and inspection methods for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) forgings produced at Plant P2. Applicable to material 1045 and to finished forging prior to machining operations.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is 28-31 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is ±0.11 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is 101.0 kg. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Measure on machined bearing faces after any heat treatment using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester. Record individual readings and verify compliance with "The hardness range for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is 28-31 HRC." Retest any location outside specification after corrective heat treatment.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore using a calibrated bore gauge or appropriate plug gauge. Verify conformance to "The bore diameter tolerance for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is ±0.11 mm." Record measured values on inspection record.
- Weight: Verify forged blank weight on a calibrated scale prior to machining. Confirm that no forging exceeds "The maximum forging weight for connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (CFW-7434-20) is 101.0 kg." Reject and segregate over-weight forgings.

Nonconformance handling
- Segregate any part failing the Requirements table. Document nonconformance on the plant NCR form and notify Quality. Evaluate cause and containment; corrective actions must include rework, reheat, or rejection as appropriate. Parts reworked shall be re-inspected to the same methods above before release.
